source_text: Ἄλλοι δὲ ἑαυτοὺς ἐξαπατῶσιν, ἀντὶ τῶν ἰδίων τῶν ἀπωλομένων, ἃ εὗρον ἀλλότρια κατέχοντες, ἵνα, ἐπειδὴ αὐτοὺς Βοράδοι καὶ Γότθοι τὰ τῶν πολεμίων εἰργάσαντο, αὐτοὶ ἄλλοις Βοράδοι καὶ Γότθοι γίνωνται. Ἀπεστείλαμεν οὖν τὸν ἀδελφὸν καὶ συγγέροντα Εὐφρόσυνον διὰ ταῦτα πρὸς ὑμᾶς, ἵνα κατὰ τὸν ἐνθάδε τύπον καὶ αὐτὸς δῴῃ ὁμοίως, καὶ ὧν δεῖ τὰς κατηγορίας προσίεσθαι, καὶ οὓς δεῖ ἐκκηρῦξαι τῶν εὐχῶν.
thought_title: Self-deception with stolen property and sending Euphrosynus to restore church order
orientation: Gregory exposes captives who keep looted goods to compensate their own losses, warns they become like the barbarians, and sends the presbyter Euphrosynus so the addressee can apply the same restitution rule and exclude the guilty from the prayers.
pass_a_gloss: Others, however, deceive themselves: in place of their own lost things, they hold fast to what belongs to others which they found, so that, since Boradoi and Goths worked the things of the enemies against them, they themselves might become Boradoi and Goths to others. We sent therefore the brother and fellow-presbyter Euphrosynus on account of these things to you, so that according to the pattern here he also might give likewise, both the accusations which must be accepted, and those who must be proclaimed excluded from the prayers.

choices.why: Middle voice with reflexive pronoun indicates self-deception; 'deceive thoroughly' is the lexical sense but the construction shows they deceive themselves.

choices.english: in place of their own lost things
choices.why: ἀντί with genitive expresses substitution; the phrase explains the motive for keeping found goods.
Proper names of the invading groups; kept as transliterated plural nouns because they function as ethnic labels.

choices.gloss: co-presbyter; the glossary maps 'presbyter' as the sense for the office; 'fellow-presbyter' captures the prefix συν-.
choices.why: σύν + γέρων = fellow elder/presbyter; the glossary uses 'presbyter' for the office, so 'fellow-presbyter' is precise.
τύπος means pattern, model, or rule; ἐνθάδε locates it in the preceding argument about restitution from Deuteronomy and Exodus.
ἐκκηρύσσω with genitive means to ban/exclude by public proclamation; the glossary defines εὐχή as 'the prayers of the church'.

pass_b_english: Others, however, deceive themselves. In place of their own lost property, they hold onto what belongs to others that they have found. They do this so that, since the Boradi and Goths treated them as enemies, they themselves might become Boradi and Goths to other people. Therefore we have sent our brother and fellow-presbyter Euphrosynus to you on account of these matters, so that he too might act according to the pattern here, both accepting the accusations that must be accepted and proclaiming excluded from the prayers those who must be excluded.
